# id: # Slayer methods from the OSRS Wiki training pages and the Ironman / Ultimate Ironman guides (see source). "?" = rate not on the wiki; "our estimate" = xp per hour divided by xp each.

name: Turael tasks (Slayer master, any level)
note: Any level; Ironman guide uses Turael for point boosting and skipping, and says Turael tasks do not give good experience; the table lists 0 points per task.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11

name: Mazchna tasks (Slayer master, combat 20)
note: Requires 20 combat or 99 Slayer; 6 points per task; Ironman guide calls Mazchna a viable Turael alternative for point boosting; no xp/h on pages.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11

name: Vannaka tasks (Slayer master, combat 40)
note: Requires 40 combat or 99 Slayer; 8 points per task; no xp/h or gear requirement on the pages read.

name: Chaeldar tasks (Slayer master, combat 70)
note: Requires Lost City and 70 combat or 99 Slayer; 10 points per task; no xp/h on pages.

name: Konar quo Maten tasks (Slayer master, combat 75)
note: Requires 75 combat or 99 Slayer; 18 points per task (about 11.1% more with the elite Kourend diary); Ironman guide says Hydras can only be assigned by Konar and suggests using Konar for milestone tasks.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11

name: Nieve/Steve tasks (Slayer master, combat 85)
note: Requires 85 combat or 99 Slayer; 12 points per task; wiki footnote "After Monkey Madness II" is on the Nieve/Steve row (applies to Steve per footnote); UIM guide recommends 85 combat for Nieve.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ultimate Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11

name: Duradel tasks (Slayer master, combat 100)
note: Requires 100 combat plus 50 Slayer or 99 Slayer; 15 points per task; the wiki's Slayer and Ironman guides both call Duradel the best master for experience; hellhounds and greater demons are commonly assigned.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11

name: Krystilia Wilderness Slayer tasks
note: Any level after one task; 25 points per task, the most of any master on the table; Ironman guide recommends at least 43 Prayer for overhead prayers and only risking replaceable gear.
source: OSRS Wiki Slayer training; Ironman Guide/Slayer 2026-11-11
